title: ichnaea.suite/2 (reader)
description: One thing you evaluate, as plain data: its cases, how to run them, what to measure and the limits.

fidelityMargin.description: For each attributed measure, the largest replay-to-recording difference that still counts as a faithful replay. A primary measure without an entry uses half its registered limit, which attribute applies. A secondary measure with a test has no registered limit, so it needs an entry: lock refuses it without one (FIDELITY_MARGIN_MISSING), and refuses an entry that names neither a primary measure nor a secondary measure with a test (FIDELITY_MARGIN_UNKNOWN).

attribute.description: Settings for attributing a change to a stage.

deterministic.description: The system is declared deterministic. Default false.
